findings.failure_path: Codex is instructed to run plain git diff, without the runner's Git safety overrides. With diff.external configured to a helper that emits nothing, that command succeeds with an empty diff despite real changes. Codex can consequently return No findings. and receive a passed receipt without seeing the candidate diff. The read-only sandbox does not prevent this output substitution.
findings.smallest_fix: Give Codex the same hardened saved diff as Claude, or supply the complete hardened Git command and environment. Add a regression that actually executes the requested command with an external diff configured.

findings.failure_path: Parsed finding titles and bodies are copied verbatim into the shareable result, and titles are printed. A valid finding quoting an exposed credential therefore persists that credential in the documented evidence output despite moving the full answer into private diagnostics. The instruction against quoting secrets does not enforce this privacy boundary.
findings.smallest_fix: Keep unredacted text in private diagnostics and sanitize finding fields before persistence or display; fail inconclusive when a safe finding excerpt cannot be produced.

findings.failure_path: Untracked entries lack framing and metadata. For fixed HEAD and tracked changes, symlinks a->xb and c->y append exactly the same bytes as a->x and bc->y: a\0xbc\0y. Switching between those candidates during review bypasses candidate_changed and produces a passed receipt for different paths and targets. Untracked executable-mode changes are also invisible.
findings.smallest_fix: Hash a canonical, length-framed representation containing each path, file type, Git mode, and target or content digest. Add symlink-collision and executable-mode regressions.

findings.failure_path: Reviewer family is inferred solely from the executable name, although private_codex_home preserves arbitrary model and custom-provider selections. A Codex configuration using an OpenAI-compatible gateway serving Claude remains eligible for a Claude implementer and is recorded as an independent codex-family review, even when both use the same model family.
findings.smallest_fix: Resolve and record the selected reviewer's actual model family, reject unverifiable configurations, and exclude the implementer's family before launch.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: containment assertions inspect arguments passed to fake executables that enforce no permissions. The attached machine-readable runs use Codex on earlier candidates; no frozen real Claude containment result or current-candidate configuration-isolation probe is supplied. The required boundary check therefore cannot establish that either invocation prevents writes and excludes inherited hooks/plugins.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply sanitized real-client containment records for this candidate and supported CLI versions, including attempted writes and hostile inherited-configuration fixtures for both reviewers.
